text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...'Abracadabra, alakazam.
Pain, pain, go away, game set'..."
choice_data_list: Is that some kind of magic spell?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. It's a little pain-relieving charm my younger sisters and I came up with long ago.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
When we were little, whenever one of us got hurt or sick,
we sisters would cast this little charm on each other—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Even when Vivlos falls and scrapes herself, she's smiling right away...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The charm had no effect, and Verxina continued to suffer from her headache.
